submitted.rationale: Of the three measured samples, index 115 (Fe0.32 Ni0.18 V0.50) gave the highest photocurrent, 2.1e-7 A. XRD showed a phase with peaks at Q ≈ 2.455, 2.858, 4.06 and 4.80 Å⁻¹ spanning the V-rich to central region. At very high V there is an extra low-Q phase, and at the Fe-rich and Ni-rich corners a different phase (peaks at Q ≈ 2.667 and 4.50 Å⁻¹). The photocurrent looks best at an intermediate Fe:V ratio near 0.65.

rejected.reason: Measured photocurrent was 0. This V-rich, Fe-poor sample has an extra low-Q phase.
Measured 7e-8 A. More Fe and less V lowered the photocurrent compared with 115.
Not measured. Their XRD shows a different phase from the region that gave photocurrent. They were also further along the Fe-rich direction, where the photocurrent was already falling.
